description: READ-ONLY: off-server backup timer and last run, disk, container health, migration versions, audit_logs count. Changes nothing.

runCommand: echo '== disk and memory =='; df -h / | tail -1; free -m | sed -n 2p
echo '== off-server backup timer =='; systemctl is-active offsite-backup.timer; systemctl list-timers offsite-backup.timer --no-pager | head -3

echo '== last runs of the backup service =='; systemctl show offsite-backup.service -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ExecMainExitTimestamp; journalctl -u offsite-backup.service --no-pager -n 12 | cut -c1-170
echo '== migration versions and row counts for the audit comparison =='
docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -tA -c "select 'erpx ' || version_num || ' audit_logs=' || (select count(*) from audit_logs) from alembic_version"
docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d pentrix -tA -c "select 'pentrix ' || version_num from alembic_version"
echo '== in-app backup jobs, newest first =='
docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -tA -F ' | ' -c "select started_at, status, size_bytes from backup_jobs order by started_at desc limit 5"
